turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not say such things, O-lan. You are my wife, my partner, and my love. I will not hear you speak of yourself as a slave.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not speak so, you are not just a slave, you are my mother and I will take care of you

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will see to it, honored mother, that your things are put in order and your son is married and settled before...before you are gone.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will not trouble you with such things, honored mother, but it would be a comfort to you to know that all is being taken care of.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am old, and my body is worn out. I must know that my son is taken care of, and that he is happy.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not worried about what will become of me, but I am worried that my son will not be taken care of

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will speak to the matchmaker and see what can be done about finding a wife for your son, honored mother. I will make sure to choose someone who will take good care of him and bring him joy.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will go now, honored mother, and speak to the matchmaker. I will also start making preparations for the wedding, as soon as is proper.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad, my daughter-in-law, that you are willing to help me with this. It is a weight off my mind, knowing that you will take care of this for me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: How can you be so calm, my wife, when I am consumed by worry and despair? You must not think of such things, not now, when you are so weak.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will try, honored mother, to make everything perfect for your son's wedding, as you wish. I will not fail you.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Why must you think of such things, O-lan? You should be resting, not worrying about our son's future.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not think of such things, O-lan. You are my wife, and I will care for you, no matter what the future brings. You must rest, and let me take care of our son's future.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I am but a simple servant, honored mother, and I do not wish to cause you any more trouble, but I will try to be of some use to you in this matter.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not talk of this, O-lan. You are exhausting yourself, and I will not have you worrying about our son's future when you should be thinking only of your own recovery.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, listen to me. You must rest and not think of such things. I will take care of everything, including our son's future.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please don't worry. I'll take care of my future, and Father will help me.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I'll be fine. Father will help me with everything, and I'll make you proud, just as you've always taught me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest until I see you settled, my son. Your father's words are kind, but I know the struggles we face, and I must make sure you are provided for.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know what struggles are, my son. It is not just a matter of marrying a woman and taking her back to the old house.
